source.name: A non-modal offcanvas panel that allows page scrolling must not trap keyboard focus
source.scope: Real upstream bug (https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/33677) at 0bbe45cd977ae69f11b4cdd55e5d5be08e4a137a. Blind to the maintainers' fix 079f2cd90c247225eb71dff4d514faf50f653416; routing auto.

journey.title: Keep editing the report with the help panel open
journey.goal: Tab can reach the amount field while the non-modal panel is open

functionalJourney.title: Open and close the policy help panel
functionalJourney.goal: The panel opens and its close button hides it

guards.title: Close the help panel from the keyboard
guards.goal: The panel's close button is reachable and closes it

plan.root_cause: The offcanvas plugin unconditionally sets aria-modal=true, role=dialog and installs a focus trap when shown, regardless of the backdrop setting. This makes the panel modal and prevents keyboard users from tabbing out to elements like #amount when data-bs-backdrop='false'.
plan.repair_strategy: Modify the show method to conditionally apply modal attributes and focus enforcement only when this._config.backdrop is true. When backdrop is false, omit aria-modal/role and simply focus the element without trapping.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Users can tab off the offcanvas panel to reach subsequent fields (such as #amount) when the panel is non-modal, restoring logical navigation order and enabling keyboard interaction with both the panel and the main form.
functional_risks: Removing aria-modal and role may change how assistive technologies announce the panel (no longer as a dialog). This is appropriate for a non‑modal offcanvas.
Without the focus trap, focus may leave the panel when the developer expects modal behavior; however, the backdrop=false configuration explicitly signals a non‑modal panel, mitigating this risk.
If any custom code relies on the modal attributes being present regardless of backdrop, it may need adjustment.
verification_requirements: With data-bs-backdrop='false', verify that the shown offcanvas does NOT have aria-modal or role attributes and that pressing Tab moves focus to the next focusable element outside the panel (e.g., #amount).
With data-bs-backdrop='true' (or omitted), verify that the offcanvas retains aria-modal='true', role='dialog' and that focus is trapped within the panel.
Ensure hiding the panel correctly reverts any changes and that no JavaScript errors are thrown in either case.
Confirm that the panel still receives initial focus when shown, regardless of backdrop setting.
